Configuring and managing a Multi-AZ deployment for Amazon RDS Multi-AZ deployments can have one standby or two standby DB instances [1]. When the deployment has one standby DB instance, it's called a Multi-AZ DB instance deployment . A Multi-AZ DB instance deployment has one standby DB instance that provides failover support, but doesn't serve read traffic [1]. When the deployment has two standby DB instances, it's called a Multi-AZ DB cluster deployment . A Multi-AZ DB cluster deployment has standby DB instances that provide failover support and can also serve read traffic [1]. A Multi-AZ DB instance deployment has the following characteristics: There is only one row for the DB instance. The value of Role is Instance or Primary . The value of Multi-AZ is Yes [2]. A Multi-AZ DB cluster deployment has the following characteristics: There is a cluster-level row with three DB instance rows under it [2].

Uma implantação Multi-AZ DB tem uma instância de espera que fornece suporte a failover, mas não atende ao tráfego de leitura [1]. Uma implantação de cluster DB Multi-AZ tem instâncias de espera que fornecem suporte a failover e também podem atender ao tráfego de leitura [1]. Uma implantação de DB Multi-AZ tem apenas uma linha para a instância DB [2]. Uma implantação de cluster DB Multi-AZ tem uma linha de nível de cluster com três linhas de instância DB abaixo dela [2].
